provider_notes: Mock supports authored key-value fixtures and narrow add-workstation/rename prompts only. Natural-language technical specs and all broader follow-ups require an explicitly selected live provider. Review every change set before accepting. Ordinary edits and exports use no model calls.

prompts.prompt: Rename Access event service to Building event viewer
prompts.expected: Rename the application only; keep all door hardware in Client.

prompts.prompt: Use push delivery from Door controllers to Access event service over HTTPS TCP 443, initiated by each controller. Keep remote unlock out of scope.
prompts.expected: Resolve delivery, protocol, port and initiator with prompt evidence; do not add control functionality.

prompts.prompt: Add a separate audit service in Z2 and connect Access event service to it. Leave the audit transport undecided.
prompts.expected: New protected audit component and unresolved interface; no invented protocol or port.
